tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) and mild leukopenia. Red cell indices are within normal limits, suggesting normocytic, normochromic anemia. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is elevated, indicating increased variability in platelet size. Further evaluation for causes of anemia and leukopenia is recommended.
